counterhypothesis.statement: UnifiedDBFingerprint is explicitly classified as SQLITE_MAIN_FILE_IDENTITY_NOT_STATE_SNAPSHOT; therefore the red discriminator does not by itself establish that continuous full-file re-fingerprinting is the correct architecture. A cheaper stable live authority witness may be required instead.

next_exact_action: Do not modify the active WP206 G2 mutation lane. Let G2 finish the one-column persisted authority-receipt replay repair. Then re-enter the exact accepted G2 source and use PR655 as separate post-G2 discriminator material. Before any successor mutation, decide the narrow intended live authority contract: full main-file fingerprint refresh, schema-only generation witness, SQLite data_version/schema_version plus bound receipt, or another explicit lease/snapshot identity.
